text.text: Earlier that day....
Control the knight by tapping in one of three lanes on the field and the direction you want him to go. Scroll left or right by sliding your finger across the screen.
You can instruct the knight to target any enemy by tapping on them. Tap the crates to destroy them.
These are your Life and Essence meters. When the essence meter turns blue, the hero can activate a special. Gain essence orbs by slaying monsters.
Look out, here comes a Skully scout! Avoid his arrows by switching lanes on the field and attacking him from a different lane.
I know training can be a drag, but as a new recruit you have to learn the basics.
text.title: Knighty

text.text: You got essence orbs for slaying that skully scout! When fighting a monster, tap the 'Sun Star' icon to activate a powerful special attack.
What's with all this ruckus? Look at this mess! What happened here?!
text.title: Go'fer

text.text: Master Go'fer, the skullys came out of nowhere! I didn't have time to warn anyone. I will go alert the HIgh General at once.
text.title: Knighty

text.text: Look eastbound to Frostburn! Something BIG is rising out of the ground. I'll notify Master Lucas. You get the remaining knights and prepare for battle.
text.title: Go'fer

text.text: Welcome to Legendaria. Gems are needed to build up your army. Tap the bouncing miner icon to recruit Miney.
Collect the gems that Miney retrieves by tapping on them. Keep collecting gems to recruit soldiers in Legendaria.
Drag the blue lane selection arrow to choose which lane the knight will emerge from the castle. Always move it to the lane you want, before creating a unit.
Great! You now have enough gems to recruit a Knight. Tap the Knighty icon below. The gem cost to recruit each hero is represented on the unit portrait.
Your knight is getting ready for battle. Tap the knight to take direct control of him and instruct him to attack by tapping the incoming skully.
You can also tap or swipe up and down to have your units change lanes.
Achieve victory during the night when the last wave of monsters is defeated!
Skullys, ADVANCE! Last skully out the door, his bones will be thrown to the wolfys!
text.title: Funny Bones

text.text: Lucas, you know those skullbrains are more dangerous at night, right? We have to defend the castle during the night.
text.title: Strider

text.text: Knightys - prepare for battle. To the castle armory!
text.title: Lucas

text.text: Tap the next monster flag to advance to the next battle. Before this battle, let's train the knightys in the armory.
text.title: Go'fer

text.text: Challenge Mode Unlocked! Access this mode by clicking the Bonus Option in the Modes Screen (Accessable from the Main Menu)
Always start by hiring a Miney to mine gems. You can upgrade his "mining rate" and "gems per trip" to speed up gem production.
Keep collecting gems. The more gems you have, the more heroes you can recruit for your army.
You will need more than one soldier to take down the monster castle. Try switching lanes to create a column of knights.
The command buttons can be used to give group orders. Tap the FORWARD ARROW button to command all soldiers to advance forward and attack!
All units will now advance forward and attack when exiting the castle. Change back to defense formation by tapping the SHIELD command button.
You can also command all your units to retreat by pressing the BACK ARROW button. Units will organize into defense formation once they reach the castle.
Command your units to advance forward and attack. Achieve victory during the DAY by destroying the monster castle!
Nice, the knightys took out those skullys quickly.
text.title: Strider

text.text: I guess the special training the High General forced upon us is actually paying off.
text.title: Lucas

text.text: It's going to get harder from here. You should constantly train the soldiers if you want to ensure victory.
text.title: Strider

text.text: Master, tap the shield icon below to enter the castle armory. You should train your soldiers before every battle.
text.title: Go'fer

text.text: The Tower Elfy is a powerful castle defender. His special fire arrows can turn monsters into dust.
text.title: Strider

text.text: If the zombies get too close to the elfys, use their special for a powerful dual-dagger strike.
text.title: Strider

text.text: Tap the Tower Elf to select him. Command him to switch tower position by selecting different lanes in front of the castle.
The group unit portrait changes based on who is selected. Tap the unit portrait at any time to UNSELECT your current unit.
Defend the castle against the incoming zombie horde!
Braaaainnnnsss...
text.title: Zombie

text.text: Oh, no, not zombies! This can't get any worse. Knightys, defense formation.
text.title: Lucas

text.text: I got your back. Elfys, ready position. Don't let those deadwalkers get too close, 'cause you don't know where they've been!
text.title: Strider

text.text: I have to help the elfys fight off the monsters. I can see these monsters have laid traps all over the battlefield.
text.title: Strider

text.text: The Royal Elfy Legion has joined your quest!                Rain of Arrows spell acquired.
Young Prince, I just got word from the dwarfys of Frostburn that the monsters are advancing to Elfy Woods!
text.title: Go'fer

text.text: These monsters must be dumber than they look if they think they can take down the Royal Elfy Legion. I'll return soon with backup.
text.title: Strider

text.text: Go help your elfy brothers, and bring some of them to us so we can defeat this plague.
text.title: Lucas

text.text: Take care of yourself, Prince. The path to Elfy Woods is dangerous.
text.title: Go'fer

text.text: With the Royal Elfy Legion, we can use a new powerfull Rain of Arrows spell.
text.title: Strider

text.text: Build a column of knightys in front of the elfys for maximum defense. Elfys - Group Formation!
text.title: Strider

text.text: The elfys are all on one lane. Tap the Formation button and units will automatically form up into a column ensuring they defend all lanes.
The group command icon changes based on who is selected. Use group control with any unit type, to organize a powerful defense and offense.
Tap the Spell Book icon to view your available spells. A Magic Sun Circle will appear, indicating where the spell will strike. Currently, you can use the spell once per a battle.
Close the book by tapping the Spell Book icon. Once the spell is ready, use Rain of Arrows to defeat the Mutant Zombie and the undead horde to achieve victory!
Prince, you're back, safe and sound! I see you brought plenty of help.
text.title: Go'fer

text.text: Glad you could join us. Ready your men, here comes trouble!
text.title: Lucas

text.text: Alright, you maggots! What do we want?
text.title: Zombie Zac

text.text: Braaaains...
text.title: Zombie

text.text: What kind of brains?!
text.title: Zombie Zac

text.text: FRESH brains!!
text.title: Zombie

text.text: Face it, humans, your time is up. Dare to get near us and you will taste the skully whirlwind shock!
text.title: Funny Bones

text.text: What a vile pile of bones. Summon us into battle and we will prove ourselves worthy of your noble cause.
text.title: Niko

text.text: Master, the Fauns have joined our army! Sometimes it's a good idea to build your troops up before attacking.
text.title: Go'fer

text.text: Fauns are medium range magical creatures that can have unpredictable effects on monsters. Destroy Funny Bones to achieve victory!
My bones will return to haunt you! hehe
text.title: Funny Bones

text.text: And we'll be there to crush them when they do.
text.title: Strider

text.text: Argh, you'd be getting on my nerves, if I had any! I'll have to teach you a lesson. Time to peel the flesh off your bones... hehe
text.title: Funny Bones

text.text: Can you believe this bonehead?
text.title: Strider

text.text: Master, this is getting serious. Perhaps We will need some help. I'll send word to the High General.
text.title: Go'fer

text.text: Why isn't this an interesting mix... a human, elf and dwarf walk into a trap...
I've heard that one half-beast, what is your business here?
text.title: Strider

text.text: Niko, musical extraordinaire. I wanted to thank you personally for dispatching those nasty undead.
text.title: Niko

text.text: Might I offer my services? We Fauns have an interesting set of skills which can prove quite effective against the walking dead.
text.title: Niko

text.text: I want to see what you can do. Let's take care of this sad excuse for a mini boss!
text.title: Lucas

text.text: Cut the monsters from escaping to Frostburn. You can destroy the crates before they hit you. Achieve victory by killing 20 monsters.
Father! What are you doing here?
text.title: Lucas

text.text: What does it LOOK like I'm doing? Cutting these creatures off! I wasn't about to let them get to Frostburn!
text.title: High General

text.text: I thought you were heading to the Valley of the Myst with the 1st Battalion?!
text.title: Lucas

text.text: I got word in Oasis that the castle was under attack. Prepare, yourself, boy, 'cause your days of basking in the sunshine are over.
text.title: High General

text.text: The Elfy Legion has pushed the monsters back towards the path to Frostburn.
text.title: Strider

text.text: We should try to cut them off before they reach Castle Frostburn.
text.title: Lucas

text.text: Master, the river path is too narrow for the army. Perhaps I should go on ahead to alert the dwarfys.
text.title: Go'fer

text.text: It's too dangerous. I'll cut them off before they reach the end of the path. I can rush them while they're on the run.
text.title: Lucas

text.text: Be careful, master.
text.title: Go'fer

text.text: Soldiers of Legendaria-- Attack!
text.title: High General

text.text: Destroy the enemy castle to achieve victory. The High General must survive
Master, you've returned safely, and with the General! Just in time - the monsters are gathering their forces for a massive assault.
text.title: Go'fer

text.text: Hello, Go'fer. I found him by himself, chasing some zombies. I pulled in an old favor at Frostburn with some of your old buddies.
text.title: High General

text.text: He insisted, Sir. When he's determined there's no convincing him otherwise. Much like someone else I know...
text.title: Go'fer

text.text: It was only a matter of time before these creeches reach Frostburn. We're here to stop them!
text.title: Dwarfy

text.text: The Royal Elfy Legion has sent for reinforcements from the woods. They'll be here by daybreak.
text.title: Strider

text.text: This is the last time I can help you. Lucas, you'll have to take over. I have to go back to Magma Mountain at once.
text.title: High General

text.text: I'm appointing you the General of the Gilded Sun. You and your friends must stop them.
text.title: High General

text.text: Understood, father. I won't fail you. We'll send them back to the Netherworld!
text.title: Lucas

text.text: The old alliance stands strong. Knightys, elfys and dwarfys, prepare for battle!
text.title: High General

text.text: Sun Kingdom endless modes unlocked! Fire Storm Spell Aquired!
Lucas, the dragon is coming. We need to be prepared for the worst. Let's use everything in our arsenal to take 'em down!
text.title: Strider

text.text: Destroy the Dragon to achieve victory!
My work here is done. It's up to you now. Find the Sunstone fragments and restore peace to Legendaria.
text.title: High General

text.text: And why do we need to find the Sunstone again?
text.title: Strider

text.text: Haven't you heard of the Legend of the Sunstone? The Sunstone holds great power.
text.title: Go'fer

text.text: It's the only thing that can stop the monsters and seal Magma Mountain for good.
text.title: High General

text.text: And how do we find these ancient war relics?
text.title: Strider

text.text: Follow the monsters' path to Frostburn. The Sunstones will find you. Let us hope that the rumors of Lord Magma's return are unfounded.
text.title: High General

text.text: Farewell, father...
text.title: Lucas

text.text: Safe travels, High General.
text.title: Go'fer

text.text: 'They will find us'? What's that supposed to mean?
text.title: Lucas

text.text: It is told that the Sages hid the Sunstone fragments in the essence of Guardians... so I guess we'll have to find those first.
text.title: Go'fer

text.text: Breeeewwwwwssss....
text.title: Zombie

text.text: Grog?
text.title: Skully

text.text: I got something special for these creeches - BA-BOMBS! All you need is a “Special” shout-out and watch'em go BOOM.
text.title: Des

text.text: Des is a hero unit and must survive the attack. Destroy the enemy castle to achieve victory.
One Sunstone down. I have a feeling that things are going to get harder from here...
text.title: Lucas

text.text: Lucas, I have been sent from the heavens to sooth your spirits. Summon me and your life essence shall be restored.
text.title: Eve

text.text: Ahh! That beautiful spirit, it just came out of the Sunstone and its heading twords the dwarfy castle! let's go!
text.title: Strider

text.text: Cheers! Welcome to Frostburn. What's the rush brotha?!
Did you see that Spirit?! Go'fer, you told me you only had sisters... but then again, I can never tell the difference.
text.title: Lucas

text.text: First cousin, once removed, Sir: Master Desmond Diminish.
text.title: Go'fer

text.text: Aye laddie, that's 'Des' for short. I was jus' chillin some brews out here, you want in?
text.title: Des

text.text: We were actually following a Sunstone spirit. Uh, your drinks are attracting the local wildlife, 'brotha'.
text.title: Strider

text.text: They're guarding the monster castle. Looks like they were expecting us. We need to find that healer spirit.
text.title: Lucas

text.text: Don't worry mate you guys go to the castle. C'mon dwarfys! Put down the brews and let's bust some skulls!
text.title: Des

text.text: Lord, I got word that the Uni was spotted just north of here.
text.title: Minion

text.text: Ah ha! It'll be mine soon... and then I will hold the power of light!
text.title: Vamp

text.text: Well, yes... but if they get to it first, they're sure to hinder our efforts.
text.title: Minion

text.text: Look, if they get too close, transform and bite them! But don't harm the Uni. I need him alive.
text.title: Vamp

text.text: But lord, there is a storm brewing near the old bridge, and the dwarfys sent for help.
text.title: Minion

text.text: Stop making excuses and go find the Uni, you useless half-breeds!
text.title: Vamp

text.text: There he is! We got you now, Uni!!
text.title: Minion

text.text: White meat! Lord Vamp will be pleased.
text.title: Minion

text.text: Spike's got ya right where he wants ya. Earth, Wind, Fire, Light, RAINBOW!
text.title: Spike

text.text: Protect the Unicorn and defeat all enemies to achieve victory. The Unicorn must survive.
These vamps have been up to no good, brotha. They attacked a group of dwarfys in broad daylight. They were looking for something.
text.title: Des

text.text: Vampires, attacking during the day? Something smells fishy here.
text.title: Strider

text.text: Let's go near the old bridge and see if we can find anything.
text.title: Lucas

text.text: Navigate Spike back to the hero castle. Achieve victory when the castle icon on the Wave Bar reaches the left side. Destroy boxes and snowmen if they get in your way.
Damn vamps won't let up. Maybe Spike should head back to the castle and talk to super friends. Time to ride the rainbow.
text.title: Spike

text.text: Where are you running off to, brotha? We're on the same side!
text.title: Des

text.text: There he goes, galloping off into the night...
text.title: Lucas

text.text: And there go the rest of those flying bloodsuckers behind him.
text.title: Des

text.text: Unicorns are fast units that hold the mystical power of light. Their special can absorb attacks and confuse foes.
Thanks for saving me, but big ol' Spike can hold his own. Spike's only got two speeds: trot 'n kill.
text.title: Spike

text.text: Hey, Spikey, d'you know why the vamps are chasing you, brotha?
text.title: Des

text.text: They want Spike to tell where the hidden Uni valley is, but Spike will never talk.
text.title: Spike

text.text: How are they able to survive during the day?
text.title: Strider

text.text: They want Spike's blood. They become day walkers. They will never #$%@ taste a drop of Spike's blood.
text.title: Spike

text.text: Join us and let us fight them together.
text.title: Lucas

text.text: Well, this horn ain't just for show. Spike'll DRILL into those creeps in no time.
text.title: Spike

text.text: My undead heart, I think I feel it beating.
text.title: Lord Vamp

text.text: Nothing Spike's horn can't cure.
text.title: Spike

text.text: Lord Vamp, our bat spies spotted the Uni in Castle Frostburn.
text.title: Minion

text.text: Be still, my undead heart, I'm coming for you!
text.title: Vamp

text.text: I have to clear this path of Wolfys. Anyone gets in my way better be ready to take a BA-BOMB fastball special.
text.title: Des

text.text: Kill 10 Wolfys to achieve victory!
The monsters are amassing a huge army to overtake Castle Frostburn.
text.title: Go'fer

text.text: Aye, it's time for backup, brotha. I'll head to the mines to alert the rest of my mates.
text.title: Des

text.text: Spike would avoid that path. Wolfys tried to ambush Spike there last week. Epic fail.
text.title: Spike

text.text: Thanks for the tip, brotha, but I'm packing extra heat. Anyone gets near me... "BOOM!"
text.title: Des

text.text: Smokey is my name, and scheming is my game. Wolfys, attack!
text.title: Smokey

text.text: Master, we have to protect the unicorns. But be careful-- wolfys are fast and capable of much higher damage than other monsters.
text.title: Go'fer

text.text: Let 'em come! They're no match for Spike.
text.title: Spike

text.text: Protect the unicorns from the wolfy pack. The blue uni must survive.
A letter has arrived.
text.title: Go'fer

text.text: “Dear good guys, we would like to thank you for incapacitating Team Vampy.
text.title: Lucas

text.text: "Thanks to your efforts, we located a group of Unis near the old bridge. We will be the ones to deliver them.
text.title: Lucas

text.text:
"Best.
Team Smokey”
text.title: Lucas

text.text: This smells like a wolfy trap.
text.title: Strider

text.text: We're not gonna let another drop of Uni blood be spilled.
text.title: Lucas

text.text: Spike hates hairy wolfys more than anything.
text.title: Spike

text.text: Destroy the enemy castle! Tap the unit icons as soon as they light up. No mining is required.
Guess who's back with backup! After I cleared the mine path, the dwarfys vowed to fight with us. They didn't even mention gems.
text.title: Des

text.text: (...Just dwarfy brew)
text.title: Des

text.text: Good, the mineys could use a break after the wolfy ambush.
text.title: Go'fer

text.text: Nice job, Des. All right, boys, it's time to kick these jokers out of Frostburn once and for all!
text.title: Lucas

text.text: Please, let's just get the Sunstone and get out of this frosted wasteland.
text.title: Strider

text.text: Aye, brotha. Dwarfys, knightys and elfys unite!
text.title: Des

text.text: ...You too, rainbow shooter.
text.title: Des

text.text: Frostburn endless modes unlocked! Ice Storm spell acquired!
Master, the Ice Guardian's breath can freeze anyone near it. We should organize a powerful army before we strike.
text.title: Go'fer

text.text: Wait, it's not over yet? Does each Sunstone have to have a monstrous bodyguard?!
text.title: Strider

text.text: Let's mount this ice sculpture's head at our victory party. Prepare for battle!
text.title: Lucas

text.text: Beware of quicksand! Don't get caught inside for too long or you will sink to your doom.
...Now THIS place almost makes me miss Frostburn.
text.title: Strider

text.text: "Beware of quicksand". Ah... do the quicksands here move backwards?
text.title: Lucas

text.text: No, master, it's just another castle rising from the ground. The Sunstone must be close by.
text.title: Go'fer

text.text: Fools! You fell right into our trap! Wolfys, attack!
text.title: Smokey

text.text: Help! Golan stuck. Sand swallows.
Oh oh, big brotha needs help. He's on our side.
text.title: Des

text.text: Is that a desert golem? Aren't they made out of sand and mud?! Something isn't right...
text.title: Strider

text.text: Spike says leave that mud monster in there. Smells like a trap.
text.title: Spike

text.text: We're not leaving him! Besides, maybe he knows something about the next Sunstone. Let's get him out of there.
text.title: Lucas

text.text: Tap Golan and get him out of the quicksand! Golems are very powerful and immune to poison, fire and ice . The golem roll can crush enemies flat.
The castle is empty. Who ever was here must of deserted when the monsters attacked.
text.title: Lucas

text.text: Hey Lucas, look! There, in the sandpit!
text.title: Strider

text.text: Someone's in trouble, mate. Let's go check it out.
text.title: Des

text.text: I know you, brotha. You're the one who rolled over a couple of wolfys down near the mine.
text.title: Des

text.text: Golan happy you help squash uglies.
text.title: Golan

text.text: Hrumph, lucky Spike was here to rescue you.
text.title: Spike

text.text: Oh, a talking little pony. My little pony miss fans from petting zoo?
text.title: Golan

text.text: Monster come attack Golan. Golan help smash monster with friend.
text.title: Golan

text.text: Aye, welcome to the team, mate. I wouldn't mess with a golem, spikey, they'll roll you out flat.
text.title: Des

text.text: All the calculations are finished! Here's the perfect plan...
text.title: Smokey

text.text: You, Goregon! Find that idiot prince of the elfys!
text.title: Smokey

text.text: My chiseled body ain't scared of NOBODY.
text.title: Goregon

text.text: Yeah, you just pamper those big muscles of yours and leave the thinking to the big brains.
text.title: Smokey

text.text: Once we capture their pointy-ear buddy, they will have to hand over the Sunstone fragment. Or else...
text.title: Smokey

text.text: How are we going to capture him? He's always surrounded by those meddling adventurers and their unicorn...
text.title: Minion

text.text: We'll hide and wait until he's alone. Then SURPRISE! We all rush him!
text.title: Smokey

text.text: What was that? I was posting my daily diet on Monsterbook, so everyone will know how I got these ROCK-HARD abs.
text.title: Goregon

text.text: Just get your gargoyles on the battlefield, and I'll do the rest.
text.title: Smokey

text.text: I better run back to the castle and warn the others.
text.title: Strider

text.text: Navigate back to the hero castle. Achieve victory when the castle icon reaches the left side of the Distance Bar.
Beautiful morning. Time for the daily duty in the ruins.
text.title: Strider

text.text: You would have thought someone would build washrooms in the castle, but I guess when it's inhabited by overgrown rock people…
text.title: Strider

text.text: There he is, you mutts! Capture him!
text.title: Smokey

text.text: Would love to stay and chat, gentlemen - gotta run!
text.title: Strider

text.text: Useless fools! He's getting away! I'll take care of this myself! oooOOOOOO
text.title: Smokey

text.text: Prince, where have you been? We've been searching all over for you.
text.title: Go'fer

text.text: I was heading to the ruins, when that crazy big wolfy rushed me.
text.title: Strider

text.text: Just barely made it back without a scratch. They're still following me.
text.title: Strider

text.text: Glad you're safe, but we've got company. Soldiers, prepare for battle!
text.title: Lucas

text.text: You fell for it again! While your missing elfy distracted you, the gargoyles snuck up on your castle! I'm so cunning! OOOOOOooooooooo
text.title: Smokey

text.text: You want Smokey?! Come and get me! ooooOOOOOO
text.title: Smokey

text.text: General Lucas. The wolfys hunt in packs. We attack one, and they all attack.
text.title: Des

text.text: Little knighty, little elfy, let me in! Or I'll huff and I'll puff, and I'll smash your face in!
text.title: Smokey

text.text: You're not getting away this time, Smokey. We've got you surrounded.
text.title: Strider

text.text: He has nowhere to go, the sand is too deep to cross behind him.
text.title: Lucas

text.text: Who said anything about leaving? Just try cornering an undead wolfy!
text.title: Smokey

text.text: King Rockman. Golan found friends to help fight rock monsters and furries.
text.title: Golan

text.text: There is... no more.... time. Fuzzies... and rock... monsters... attack... no one... help... golems.
text.title: Golem King

text.text: Friends come to help when Golan stuck. Rockman powerful. Together we fight monsters.
text.title: Golan

text.text: Golems... have no… choice… We must... fight... or no hope... for Oasis... Golems get ready.... ROLL ON!
text.title: Golem King

text.text: Kill 25 monsters to achieve victory!
Where are you headin' off to, mate? It's dangerous out there.
text.title: Des

text.text: Golan go warn Golem King. If monster come, Golan crush and smash and roll your head in.
text.title: Golan

text.text: Fellow... humanoids... Stop these... imposters from.... destroying our.... land.... Golems; SMASH AND ROLL!!!
text.title: Golem King

text.text: Prepare for battle!
text.title: Lucas

text.text: Destroy the enemy castle to achieve Victory. The Golem King must survive.
Golan is back, and he brought a huge friend!
text.title: Des

text.text: Good timing, we could use all the help we can get...
text.title: Lucas

text.text: Golan bring Golem King. We fight rock monsters and fuzzy ones together.
text.title: Golan

text.text: Golems across.... Legendaria will.... fight alongside.... you. Monster.... not bother.... us no more....
text.title: Golem King

text.text: Desert Oasis endless modes unlocked! Lightning Storm spell acquired!
Golems fulfilled... duty. We must... recharge this... night. Good Luck... young... warriors...
text.title: Golem King

text.text: Our deepest gratitude, old rocky ones.
text.title: Strider

text.text: We hope our paths cross again. Well done, Golan.
text.title: Lucas

text.text: Hey, brotha, when are you gonna get all huge, full of crystals and awesome?
text.title: Des

text.text: Golan must train night and day. Then must find magic crystal rock.
text.title: Golan

text.text: Hurmph. Spike doesn't need no magic rock to be awesome.
text.title: Spike

text.text: Chill, Spikey. You can prove yourself against this huge flying lizard coming our way. Get ready!
text.title: Des

text.text: Endless mode unlocked!
Release the widows! We made sure they were extra hungry just for you, wizzy!
text.title: Goregon

text.text: It was you who stole my spell book! I will send you foul creatures back to the Netherworld!
text.title: Felix

text.text: Use the arrows below to defend the castle. Kill 50 Widows to achieve victory!
Snow, desert, swamp, these places keep getting worse. The Golem King better be right about it being here.
text.title: Strider

text.text: It makes sense that the sages hid the Sunstone fragment here. Who would ever want to come to this place?
text.title: Lucas

text.text: INGENIOUS! I'VE DONE IT! You there, sonny, what day is it?
I've lost track.. but hold on, we have a few questions for....
text.title: Lucas

text.text: LOOK AT MY EYES WHEN I'M TALKING TO YOU! THE YEAR, SON! TELL ME THE YEAR!
Listen...
text.title: Lucas

text.text: HOOT -up here! I've been trapped in this owl body ever since I came back from the past. Help me find my spell book!
Listen, gramps, we're on an important quest, we don't have time for babbling fools.
text.title: Strider

text.text: Finally found you, hairless monkeys! We've got a special treat for you. Unleash the widows!
text.title: Goregon

text.text: Don't worry, boys! Even in this body, I can still command enough magic to deal with these buffoons. Step aside and you will believe!
Whatever you say, old man.
text.title: Strider

text.text: Defend the castle!
Hoot! That will teach you to mess with a Wizard of the Gilded Sun. So youngsters, will you help me find my spell book?!
text.title: Felix

text.text: Impressive, gramps. I haven't seen anyone control essence like that since I was a boy. But we don't have time for side quests...
text.title: Lucas

text.text: MY NAME IS Felix. Feeeeeel Eeeecks! Hoot!
text.title: Felix

text.text: You have a screw loose, laddie?
text.title: Des

text.text: Sorry, master, this Felix fellow is convinced he's trapped in that little owl's body. Though I admit, it's a bit eerie how that owl keeps to its place.
text.title: Go'fer

text.text: I can help you, but you'll have to help get my brain back into this body! Hoot!
text.title: Felix

text.text: You're welcome to stick around if you can show us the way to the Valley of the Myst.
text.title: Lucas

text.text: Hoot! I know the way, but you have to help me find it. My spell book! I can help stop the Monster Wars!
text.title: Felix

text.text: Monster Wars, laddie? You've lost your mind, but any enemy of these creeches is a friend of mine.
text.title: Des

text.text: Avoid the poisonous swamp and destroy the monster castle to achieve victory!
You better not fail me this time.
text.title: Goregon

text.text: But big boss... the Mystic Swamp harbors all sorts of poisons, and plagues...
text.title: Minion

text.text: And now they have that old Wiz on their side.
text.title: Minion

text.text: He's pretty useless in that bird body. As long as he doesn't aquire any Moonstones, he poses no real threat. Now GO!
text.title: Goregon

text.text: ...and DO NOT step in the swamp, you brainless lumps!
text.title: Goregon

text.text: I knew one of you had my spellbook! Hoot! Now I just need to find some Moonstones and I will be as good as new!
text.title: Felix

text.text: Avoid poison puddles and kill 30 monsters to achieve victory!
GOBBLING GENERATORS, MY SPELL BOOK! HOOT! Those dastardly creatures stole it! Come, gentle beast! Lend me your back!
text.title: Felix

text.text: Wha? Whoa, let's be clear! Ain't no one ready to ride THIS Stallion!
text.title: Spike

text.text: Egad, horses haven't been domesticated yet! Hoot! I'll just have to find it by myself!
text.title: Felix

text.text: Sssurprissse, ssstttupid fatttt mineeyssss. Your gem mining dayssssss are over!
text.title: Minion

text.text: YIKES! They blocked off the castles!! RUN!!!
text.title: Miney

text.text: It's a trap! They have us surrounded! Run into the forest!
text.title: Go'fer

text.text: I'ts over! The Trees are coming alive! I think I'm going to fain...
text.title: Miney

text.text: Relax little ones. We are not going to hurt you. We are the protectors of the forests. The Monsters have destroyed us for far too long...
text.title: Sprite

text.text: Tree Sprites can summon bomb flowers that explode when stepped on! Destroy the monster castle to achieve victory! The Sprite must survive.
Oh, good, the reaps are here! We have a MAJOR hero problem.
text.title: Minion

text.text: Well, yessss... uh huh. Yessss, we will take care of this 'problem'. We are the bessst at what we do.
text.title: Reap

text.text: Attack the problem at itsss core...
text.title: Reap

text.text: Yeah, I'll smash this core! I ran 8 miles and did 200 push-ups today. Check out my biceps and triceps.
text.title: Goregon

text.text: Capture their minerssss! No minersss = No heroesss! Got it? We will take care of the fatties.
text.title: Reap

text.text: So, you're saying that you don't want to see my "bi's and tri's" ?!
text.title: Goregon

text.text: General Lucas! A Tree Sprite just came to life and informed me of terrible news! Gof'er and the miners have been captured!
text.title: Des

text.text: We tried to do our best to protect the little ones, but the reaps were one steps ahead.
text.title: Sprite

text.text: Thank you for all you've done. We can take it from here.
text.title: Strider

text.text: We refuse to be rooted down while the forests get destroyed by these ravaging beasts. The Tree Sprites will help you.
text.title: Sprite

text.text: Very Well... Lemmy, we're gonna need you! Let's make these gargoyles wish they were never animated!
text.title: Lucas

text.text: Yes, sir! Back in Frostburn I was quite the miney in my younger days. Lemmy at your service!
text.title: Lemmy

text.text: Gargoyles, make sure you get your daily protein intake. Dinner is served hot tonight!
text.title: Goregon

text.text: What did you do with Go'fer and the mineys?!
text.title: Lucas

text.text: That thing is bigger than my house. You think he's trying to over-compensate for something?
text.title: Strider

text.text: I WORK OUT. You'll never find your precious dwarfy miners now. Muahhaha.
text.title: Goregon

text.text: Great, Go'fer was kidnapped by a self-obsessed gargoyle. Hey, buff guy! I think I see some flab around the edges!
text.title: Strider

text.text: You dare call my perfectly chiseled body FLABBY?! You'll pay, flesh bags!!
text.title: Goregon

text.text: Rescue 10 miners to achieve victory!
Thank you again Tree Sprite. Without your help our friends could have been done for.
text.title: Lucas

text.text: This is our world too brave knight. I come from an Island far away. And I can't let the same thing that happend in Mysteria happen here.
text.title: Sprite

text.text: Lucas, the Tree Sprites have proven themselves useful. Perhaps we will need their help.
text.title: Strider

text.text: I will be withdrawn to the earth and wait for your summons.
text.title: Sprite

text.text: Welcome aboard! Spike, you're the only one fast enough to catch them. Follow their scent and rescue Go'fer and the miners!
text.title: Lucas

text.text: Spike will rescue mini miners!
text.title: Spike

waves.title: Pay the toll of the Swamp Troll!

text.text: You have to pay the toll if you want to pass the troll...
text.title: Felix

text.text: Must pay the toll. Follow me, he he he.
text.title: Felix

text.text: Just what are you babbling about, Felix? Where you going? Hey, wait up!
text.title: Lucas

text.text: I have a baaad feeling about this place, brotha. Sounds like a troll curse to me.
text.title: Des

text.text: Eeech, what a foul stench! Hey, where are you going, old man?!
text.title: Strider

text.text: You have to pay troll toll to make it to the goal. You have to pay the toll if you want to pass Coco the Troll!
text.title: Coco

text.text: A singing troll? Now I've seen everything. We're not paying you anything, troll. Let us pass!
text.title: Lucas

text.text: Aye brotha, that creech has a Moonstone stuck in his belly. Let me use my axe to chisel it out...
text.title: Des

text.text: If you refuse to pay the troll toll, then Coco will take your soul!
text.title: Coco

text.text: Felix is under a troll curse. Protect the wizard as you make your way to the Valley of the Myst.
Spike's not back yet. He is going to need our help.
text.title: Lucas

text.text: It will only take me half a day's walk to track him through the Valley of the Myst. But they'll be expecting us.
text.title: Strider

text.text: We have to find them, Strider.
text.title: Lucas

text.text: 100% chance of being a trap? Sounds like a suicide mission. Count me in, lads!
text.title: Des

text.text: The Valley of the Myst, boy??! Yes, I'm familiar with it. It's where I... well, c'mon now, follow me. I know the way...
text.title: Felix

text.text: What's that bright light?!
text.title: Lucas

text.text: Booyah! I've traveled sideways through time to help you boneheads! By the power of the Sunstone, let the mineys rest! We all fight as one on this day.
text.title: Felix

text.text: Destroy the monster castle! The Light Wizard must survive.
Thank the heavens, sir! They were making us sing "Hi Ho" repeatedly.
text.title: Go'fer

text.text: Good to see you too, Go'fer. Well done, Spike. Now where's that crazy wizard?
text.title: Lucas

text.text: Master Lucas, he disappeared into the myst. He never made it back with us.
text.title: Go'fer

text.text: We've got company, lads! The death-bringing kind. Is there any other?
text.title: Des

text.text: Spike had a run in with those deathies. They tried to reap me, but I used my rainbow power to get away.
text.title: Spike

text.text: 'Reap' you?
text.title: Strider

text.text: They use a Reap Ray to send your soul to the Netherworld. Spike ain't scared, but you should be.
text.title: Spike

text.text: We could really use that crazy wizard right now. Prepare for battle!
text.title: Lucas

text.text: Mystic Swamp endless modes unlocked! Rainbow Sorm Spell acquired!
Hold your posssssition reapsssss. Do not let them advance passsssst the Valley!
text.title: Grimm

text.text: Is that the last Guardian? It looks like it already died a while ago...
text.title: Lucas

text.text: Ohhh, and it brought little skull 'halfings' to assist it. I wonder if we can hit one of them from here...
text.title: Strider

text.text: Hold on, prince, we must gather all our forces if we hope to get past those Death Reaps and Skull Guardians.
text.title: Go'fer

text.text: Master Felix, you showed up just in time.
text.title: Go'fer

text.text: Good to see you, old man. What was that white glow around you, and all that crazy light essence? What happened to you?
text.title: Lucas

text.text: Yes, Felix, that's my name. Did I time travel again? I had a vision. They must have got it to warp me again!
text.title: Felix

text.text: I come back to you now, with knowledge of how to get to Magma Mountain. Follow me, boys!
text.title: Felix

text.text: Yeah gramps, we've heard that one before...
text.title: Strider

text.text: Destroy 20 wooden boxes to achieve victory!
I fail to see the connection between the Sunstone and Magma Mountain.
text.title: Strider

text.text: The High General said that all of the undead are spewing out from here. He travelled here to find out how to stop them.
text.title: Go'fer

text.text: By the jovial jockeys of justice! The tectonics of this tundra are simply tantalizing.
text.title: Felix

text.text: What's he saying? I think I liked him better when he thought he was the owl...
text.title: Lucas

text.text: He's saying that he's going to use the force essence to build the army a 'grand' fort.
text.title: Go'fer

text.text: Boy, become the hero of time and fetch me some wood. Behold my awesome power!
text.title: Felix

text.text: It's General Lucas, and did no one inform him that I'M the one who gives orders around here?
text.title: Lucas

text.text: I can't believe this magic disguise worked. We just marched right through Magma Mountain and not one monster noticed us.
text.title: Lucas

text.text: I guess I underestimated you, old man. Hey, what's that smell?
text.title: Strider

text.text: Sorry, brotha, this zombie body stinks. I say we should've walked right to the front door and let them taste my axe!
text.title: Des

text.text: When does this spell wear off?! Spike's got hair growing everywhere and no horn. So what do we do now, gramps?
text.title: Spike

text.text: Lay the Sunstones in a diamond and surround them by the embers of the mountain. Wear off?! Um, that 'Dispel' is here somewhere...
text.title: Felix

text.text: No time for talk. Monster coming.
text.title: Golan

text.text: You foooolssss, you let them infiltrate! Sssssstop them!
text.title: Grimm

text.text: Here they come. Protect the Sunstones!
text.title: Lucas

text.text: Something's happening!
text.title: Lucas

text.text: Oh, man, earthquaaaaaaake. Is Magma Mountain erupting?!
text.title: Strider

text.text: Stand back!
text.title: Felix

text.text: I finally awakened from slumber. The spirit of Asher will help you.
text.title: Enix

text.text: What does he mean by 'Asher's spirit'?
text.title: Strider

text.text: ALL Reapsssss... the time hasssss come! Desssssstroy that Phoenix!!
text.title: Grimm

text.text: Oh, oh. This does NOT look good. They're cutting us off.
text.title: Strider

text.text: There are too many of them! Everyone, retreat to the fort!
text.title: Lucas

text.text: Stand back, Lucas! Today the Gilded Sun Army fights back!
text.title: High General

text.text: Kill the Grimm Death Reap and the rest will vanish! Soldiers of Legendaria, charge!!!
text.title: High General

text.text: Magma Mountain is erupting! We have to get out of here!
text.title: Lucas

text.text: It could only mean one thing, Lord Magma is back. Lucas, you have the power to stop them.
text.title: High General

text.text: Protect Enix at all costs. It's the key to Lord Magma's demise.
text.title: High General

text.text: Understood father, they're not going to get away with this.
text.title: Lucas

text.text: HAHAHAHA, thank you for lifting the seal. The Lord of Darkness will be pleassssed. Ssssoul reapssss retreat!
text.title: Grimm

text.text: Kill 50 monsters and gather their essence to fuse the Sunstone. Lucas the Skully must survive
I saw it with my own eyes, people can fly! Like birds!
text.title: Felix

text.text: Yeah, I know you thought you were a bird. I'm asking again, what did you learn about the Sunstone? You said you've seen it before.
text.title: Lucas

text.text: Pagan Pegasus! The Sunstone?!
text.title: Felix

text.text: Yes... you mentioned it in the Valley of the Myst.
text.title: Lucas

text.text: THE SUNSTONE! YES - I've traveled sideways through time to tell you! It's the key to ending the Legendary Wars!
text.title: Felix

text.text: "And he will fuse the Sunstone upon the doorstep of the Netherworld, and one from the ashes shall rise!"
text.title: Felix

text.text: I was there when Asher, the demon warrior, was able to unleash the power to stop evil.
text.title: Felix

text.text: That legend was from centuries ago, but humor me, old man. Just how do we fuse the Sunstone, again?
text.title: Strider

text.text: Aye, not to mention that you want us to get to Magma Mountain's entrance, which is sure to be surrounded by every type of monster in Legendaria!
text.title: Des

text.text: Use the essence of the fallen to fuse the stones together, and four shall become one. My disguise spell will get us to the gates.
text.title: Felix

text.text: The monsters were hunting him for a reason. He has proven useful. I trust you to lead the way, Felix.
text.title: Lucas

text.text: You took my treasure! Lord Magma blessed Coco with zombie power in the Netherworld. Not even death can keep me from killing you!
text.title: Coco

text.text: That's one ugly treasure troll. We better stick together.
text.title: Strider

text.text: Aye, brotha. And you thought he smelled bad before...
text.title: Des

text.text: That smell is a spell which I did cook; it will protect Zombie Coco from your magic book. HAHAHAHA!
text.title: Coco

text.text: Use group control and command all the heroes to destroy the Zombie Troll! The phoenix must survive the endless horde of the undead.
Felix, you want to explain what that was all about?! Why did the eruption start right after we resurrected Enix?!
text.title: Lucas

text.text: Yes, resurrecting Enix did lift the seal and cause the eruption. But it's the only way to seal the Netherworld portal.
text.title: Felix

text.text: Thanks for not mentioning that earlier, brotha.
text.title: Des

text.text: The wizard speaks the truth! It's what we set out to do here. You can't destroy him when he's trapped in the Netherworld.
text.title: High General

text.text: Lucas, you must use Enix as Asher once did, and seal the portal gates for good. Only then will the eruption subside.
text.title: Felix

text.text: I hate to interrupt, brotha, but the undead horde cut off the path back to the fort.
text.title: Des

text.text: We have to get back to the fort, or the monsters will have us surrounded.
text.title: Strider

text.text: Go'fer, you and the miners escort my father and the wounded back to the fort. Use the cover of the mist to get away.
text.title: Lucas

text.text: Here come much dead monster. Golan Smash N' Roll!
text.title: Golan

text.text: Were gonna push through this zombie horde. Enix, lend us your power and burn them all!
text.title: Lucas

text.text: Ssssend every able undead body to attack that Fort! I don't want to sssseeee one human ssssstanding.
text.title: Grimm

text.text: The Soul Squad is at your service.
text.title: Minion

text.text: Good! Go dessssstroy that phoenix!
text.title: Grimm

text.text: Lord Magma needsssss more sssssouls to regain full power!
text.title: Grimm

text.text: Yes, stupid heroes, Funny Bones is back! Every skully in bone back mountain, prepare for a spin attack!!
text.title: Funny Bones

text.text: Master, the Netherworld army approaches.
text.title: Go'fer

text.text: Well, what are we waiting for? Spike is ready to trample some bones!
text.title: Spike

text.text: Master, perhaps we should try to summon Enix before they all get here.
text.title: Go'fer

text.text: They're sending an army of each monster. The whole ground is covered with crawlers.
text.title: Go'fer

text.text: Let Golan take care of crawly. Roll and Squish is what Golan does best.
text.title: Golan

text.text: Say hello to the the new and improved Goregon. I'm bigger, faster, stronger and prettier than ever! Gargoyles! Get ready to squash these flesh bags!
text.title: Goregon

text.text: MORE gargoyles?! Don't these things ever die?!
text.title: Lucas

text.text: As long as the Netherworld portal remains open, monsters will keep crawling out.
text.title: Felix

text.text: Well, let's finish this stone brain and destroy those gates!
text.title: Strider

text.text: Spike will crumble these slow gargoyles. Send the Unis, and Spike will show them the true meaning of Double Rainbow Power!
text.title: Spike

text.text: Vamp and Smokey are fighting each other. Now is our chance to take them both down for good!
text.title: Lucas

text.text: I'll be the one to deliver those delicious humans to Lord Magma. He will reward me with all the Uni in Legendaria! Hahaha!
text.title: Vamp

text.text: Shut up, Vamp! Smokey and the wolfys will destroy these brainless wimps. Get your vamps out of my way, or else! OOoOoooooooo
text.title: Smokey

text.text: Both Team Vamp and Team Smokey are planning a huge attack. Use your limited gem resources to setup a formidable defense before they arrive.
Master Lucas, while the soldiers were fighting off the skullys and widows, the vamps and wolfys have advanced to the fort.
text.title: Go'fer

text.text: Vamp and Smokey, teaming up?! Didn't see that one coming. But we survived an ambush before, and we'll do it again.
text.title: Strider

text.text: I do have troubling news. The magma mines have been exahusted. It will take us a couple of days to dig deeper for gems.
text.title: Go'fer

text.text: Looks like we will have to use our emergency reserves. We have limited funds so lets be smart on how we setup our defenses.
text.title: Lucas

text.text: Golan and Golems will make good defense. Ready to Smash and Roll!
text.title: Golan

text.text: Netherworld Army, thisssss world is ourssssss for the taking! Reap the ssssssoul of every flesssssssh walker! Lord Magma will return!
text.title: Grimm

text.text: Not if we stop you first! Soldiers of Legendaria, destroy the Netherworld Gates!!
text.title: Lucas

text.text: Arise Lord Magma, arise!!!
text.title: Grimm

text.text: To you I send all the lost souls of the Netherworld!
text.title: Grimm

text.text: That was creepy.
text.title: Strider

text.text: Destroy the Netherworld portal for good! CHARGE!
text.title: Lucas

text.text: Finally, face to face with Grimm, Master of Reaps. Prepare for a castle onslaught!
text.title: Lucas

text.text: Aye, brotha. Let's make sure he doesn't have time to come back and destroy that portal for good!
text.title: Des

text.text: Elfys, ready your bows! This is going to be a battle to remember.
text.title: Strider

text.text: Prepare to destroy the Netherworld Portal Gates!
text.title: Lucas

text.text: Endless mode unlocked!
HUMANKIND, your time is at an end. Prepare to be swallowed into the bowels of the Netherworld!
text.title: Lord Magma

text.text: Ah ha ha ha ha... AHA HA HA HA HA HA HAH HA.
text.title: Grimm

text.text: *wheeze*
text.title: Grimm

text.text: Stupid skullyman needs inhaler?
text.title: Golan

text.text: You plebians! Misguided, ignorant foolssssss! Turn your back on that monstrosity in your midsssst, else I ssshall sssssmite you all where you ssstand!
text.title: Grimm

text.text: Pffft, you ain't nuthin'. Spike could take on the whole Reap army alone.
text.title: Spike

text.text: Enough!
text.title: Lucas

text.text: Ah, but see, being sssimple minds, you kept making all thessse assssumptionsss... But you will losssssse...
text.title: Grimm

text.text: Now that the Sssssunstones are no more, the ssssseal is broken! Arissse Lord Magma, and behold the POWER!
text.title: Grimm

text.text: Legendarian soldiers, tonight we stand as one! Let us finish this Legendary War! ATTACK!
text.title: Lucas

text.text: Magma Mountain endless modes unlocked! New sidescrolling level unlocked!
My old nemesis. You don't belong in this world. Sun light - lend me your power!
text.title: Enix

text.text: Asher! From fire you were born, and to fire you shall return!
text.title: Lord Magma

text.text: Gather the essence of all fallen monsters and unleash Enix's power to stop Lord Magma!
You're not getting away, fiend! Enix, it's time to end this once and for all! As your master, I choose you to slay the beast and end this Legendary War!
text.title: Lucas

text.text: Spirit of Asher! So you have requested, so it shall be done.....
text.title: Enix

text.text: A bit formal for a flying fire beast, isn't he?
text.title: Strider

text.text: Hush, pointy-eared one. There he goes once again! The future is now and that time is here! Ouch!
text.title: Felix

text.text: You feel that, laddie?! Wake up, the rest of the monsters approach. This won't be the last time these creeches taste my axe.
text.title: Des

text.text: Or Spike's horn!
text.title: Spike

text.text: Golan's fist stronger! Smash and Roll!!
text.title: Golan

text.text: This ends now! ATTACK!!
text.title: Lucas

text.text: You have broken into the Netherworld, a place where no hero has dare set foot before. Be cautious as you preceed further into the darkness, The monster army will not take kindly to your presence.
Free 15 of your companions by smashing the cages they are trapped in!
You have released enough Knightys, now free the Rouge!
How dare you free my prisoners! I will blow you to smithereens!
text.title: Goontar

text.text: Defeat the Imp King Goontar!
The Cyclops' eye sees all. The Monsters have gone too far this time and must be taught a lesson!
text.title: Cyclops

text.text: Goby tells all Gremlins - Don't let that creature near the jails! He will ruin everything! Nuyk Nuyk.
text.title: Goby

text.text: Goontar King of Imps, at your service. Imps protect the cells and destroy that vile creature!
text.title: Goontar

text.text: Use Rogue the Assasin to help your army achieve victory.
Defend the portal until the Skully Archer Lieutenant & Giant Skully Boss attack.
The Cyclops has done it! My spell..it worked! I feel stronger, wiser, and beardier!
text.title: FELIX

text.text: The Portal is open for you to save your friends. If you need me, call upon the power of Skyhaven, and I shall join you in battle.
text.title: Cyclops

text.text: Thank you for saving me. I never thought I would ever get out of there alive.
It was our pleasure, but who are you and what are you doing down here?
text.title: Strider

text.text: The name's Rogue. I'm an assassin from Legendaria. I was captured and brought here.
text.title: Rogue

text.text: What do the monsters want with all these prisoners?
text.title: Lucas

text.text: I don't know but I'm willing to help you find out.
text.title: Rogue

text.text: Everyone hurry through the portal. We must save the prisoners!
text.title: Felix

text.text: Look, more Knights! These ones escaped. Hey everyone over here!
text.title: Lucas

text.text: Wait one second... those are no normal Knights!
text.title: Strider

text.text: Aye, Something doesn't smell right here brotha.
text.title: Des

text.text: Not what you expected? We have found a new master and now embrace the monster inside us. Come joins us!
text.title: Deadknight

text.text: These are the monsters that caught me before. Just try to get near me again!
text.title: Rogue

text.text: Master, what were those things?!
text.title: Go'fer

text.text: I'm not sure but they appeared to be human once. Whatever they are things are going to get tougher the deeper we go into the Nether.
text.title: Rogue

text.text: You aren't getting passed my tribe, so you need not worry what lies beyond.

waves.title: Destroy the Wolfys with a Vengeance!

text.text: You dare try to curse me and drag me to this place?! I will spear each and last one of you!
text.title: Nour

text.text: Destroy the monster castle! The Centaur must survive.
Wait, don't strike him. A curse has been lifted. These creatures are not our enemies.
text.title: Felix

text.text: I apologize. I was not myself. My name is Nour, chief of the Centaur tribe. We were dragged down here against our will.
text.title: Nour

text.text: So that's their plan, they are stealing overworlders and poisoning their minds.
text.title: Rogue

text.text: Bingo genius. Did you miss me? Now give me back those Centaurs! Volde the Necromancer will not be pleased.
text.title: Smokey

text.text: Ohhh not this guy again! How many times do we have to fight you furball before you get a clue?!
text.title: Strider

text.text: We are not puppets in your meaningless schemes! Centaurs, it's time to defeat this mumbling mutt once and for all!
text.title: Nour

text.text: It feels good to fight the forces of evil once more. Your cause is just, my tribe will see it through or die trying.
text.title: Nour

text.text: That's exactly my plan. Zombies RISE!
text.title: Volde

text.text: I smell fresh meat, this should be a tasty battle. Go forth my horde and feast on these intruders!
text.title: Zombie Zac

text.text: The monsters have fortified their castle! Use the catapult's Special to destroy the barricade and achieve Victory. The catapult must survive.
Working out in the Netherworld has really done wonders on my abs. I am back and more swollen than ever! Even if you defeat me you will never make it past this fortress.
text.title: Goregon

text.text: That pebble brain looks stronger than ever and has barricaded his castle. We are going to need a catapult if we want to move forward brotha.
text.title: Des

text.text: Master, you're in luck! There is one here, but protect it at all costs as it is the only one that we brought through the portal.
text.title: Go'fer

text.text: Whew! We made it past that hurdle.
text.title: Lucas

text.text: Watch out! Something big is headed our way.
text.title: Rogue

text.text: Ewwww, what is that horrible smell?
text.title: Spike

text.text: Shut your traps you dirty little things! I maybe rotting, but I can still squash you like bugs!
text.title: Coco

text.text: Looks like they defeated Coco again. I told you that rotting pile of flesh could never hold them off.
text.title: Lich

text.text: Maybe, but there is no way that those ssssssun loving little freaks will get past usssssss.
text.title: Medusa

text.text: Oh dear, that is sooo gross. That thing has snakes for hair.
text.title: Healer

text.text: Yes, and I have seen creatures like her where I am from, and they are never very nice.
text.title: Sprite

text.text: Golan thinks that down here, nothing has been very nice.
text.title: Golan

text.text: How dare you inssssult me and my loveliesssss. Attack!!
text.title: Medusa

levels.title: Level 6-10 Who let the Rex out?!

text.text: I've had enough of you. The line must be drawn here! No further.
text.title: Lich

text.text: Should I release Rex your Evilness? He looks ever so hungry. Nyuk Nyuk!
text.title: Goby

text.text: Aye, do your worst! I'll slice all three of his heads with my axe!
text.title: Des

text.text: Free 15 Heroes from eggs and squish 15 spider egg sacks to achieve victory!
All of your troops have been defeated!
text.title: Knighty

text.text: Are those webs on the ground?
text.title: Des

text.text: They sure are, and it looks like it's spider hunting season again.
text.title: Strider

text.text: I don't know how you can be excited, Brotha. I hate creepy spiders.
text.title: Des

text.text: You just charged head first into a battle with a giant three-headed beast, and your afraid of a couple of little spiders?!
text.title: Rogue

text.text: Lassie, I hate spiders... and down here, they are never little.
text.title: Des

text.text: AwooOOOOOOOOOOooo!
text.title: Smokey

text.text: Will you stop with that incessant howling? You'll give away the oportunity of surprise!
text.title: Lord Vamp

text.text: You do your thing, and I'll do mine. These trespassing freaks are on our turf now and I am gonna teach them the meaning of pain! AwooOOOOOOOoo!
text.title: Smokey

text.text: Is it just me, or does it feel like every time we fight these monsters they get easier and easier to defeat?
text.title: Strider

text.text: Maybe, it's just that you are getting cuter... I mean stronger.
text.title: Eve

text.text: I am sure it doesn't hurt that we have made a few new friends along the way.
text.title: Felix

text.text: It has been my tribes greatest honor to fight at your side. You are all truely heroes!
text.title: Nour

text.text: Indeed, Nour. My dagger sings with joy to be used against evil forces once more.
text.title: Rogue

text.text: Enough with the pleasantries! Coco is back and better than ever. No more stinkin' flesh. The Gremlin King Goontar has given me a new arm to crush your puny little heads!
text.title: Coco

text.text: Coco AGAIN!?! He just wont give up.
text.title: Lucas

text.text: Golan stick that shiny new arm up...
text.title: Golan

text.text: Ahem, Golan careful, there are Mineys around! But I agree, let's tame this fowl monster.
text.title: Eve

text.text: Excuse me missy!? Have you seen my suave new Hairdo? Looking this good is no easy feat! Now taste da fury of my axe!
text.title: Coco

text.text: That's it! You guys are are really starting to bother me. You totally made me miss my morning Nether run and photoshoot. Now none of the girls on Monsterbook will know what I had for breakfast!
text.title: Goregon

text.text: I don't care how many squats you can do or pounds you can lift! You are still going down like the rest of them.
text.title: Sprite

text.text: How dare you! You little green twig! EVERYONE CARES! AHHHHHH!!!
text.title: Goregon

text.text: Mwa HAHAHA! You have fallen right into our trap.
text.title: Volde

text.text: That's the same Necromancer that tried to brain wash me.
text.title: Rogue

text.text: Heh Heh Heh... I have other plans for your brains, delicious Brraaaiiins!
text.title: Zombie Zac

text.text: Hush Zac! I was just about to unvail my genius plan to these doomed adventurers!
text.title: Volde

text.text: Why do villans always think this is a good idea?
text.title: Strider

text.text: You've got me... Maybe they think their confidence is intimidating. Whatever the reason, I will no longer be part of it!
text.title: Rogue

text.text: Silly Assassin, I knew that transporting you this deep into the Netherworld was hopeless. It was I that made sure you suceeded thus far. I knew that If I let you go... You would come right to me.
text.title: Volde

text.text: I'll never let you get your hands on her again!
text.title: Strider

text.text: True that, my pointy eared friend!! There isn't a horde of zombies anywhere that can stand up to the power of RAINBOW!
text.title: Spike

text.text: BRING IT ON!
text.title: Zombie Zac

text.text: Oh, it's already been brought'n!                                                       *Double Snap*
text.title: Sprite

text.text: It is a wonder that you have made it this far, a pity that I must now destroy you.
text.title: Grimm

text.text: Indeed, Grimm and I have really enjoyed watching the stuggle thus far.
text.title: Funny Bones

text.text: Your good times are through. By the power of light we will cleanse this wretched place fo all eternity.
text.title: Felix

text.text: I shall show you no mercy!
text.title: The Sky Wizard

text.text: Felix has infused himself with the power of the great Wizard of Skyhaven. The Sky Wizard must survive!
That wizard is out of control! We must stop him now. Our back up is not yet ready...hehe
text.title: Funny Bones

text.text: I will not be stopped! Behold the power of Skyhaven!
text.title: Sky Wizard

text.text: hehe... He does look pretty flashy!
text.title: Funny Bones

text.text: Silence you bag of bones! That wiz is nothing but an over inflated balloon just waiting to be popped! We have our own power player... unleash the Mantis!
text.title: Bone Head

text.text: My brood shall suck away your very life essence. To attack us is certian death!
text.title: Mantis Matron

text.text: I am the great Cyclops of Skyhaven, you dirty bugs have no chance against my might!
text.title: Cyclops

text.text: Use your forces to defeat the Mantis army.  Advance forward, but don't walk off the edges or you will fall to your doom.
text.title: Cyclops

text.text: Send the Heroes straight down lanes and use specials to take down your enemies. Protect the Cyclopes and destroy the Mantis Guardians to achieve victory!
We can not be defeated so easily. While you were busy fighting but one of our family, the rest of us have arrived! You are doomed!
text.title: Mantis

text.text: Ahhhh! Master, there are too many of them!
text.title: Miney

text.text: Aye Brutha', but stand fast! We cannot give up now!
text.title: Des

text.text: Indeed Dez, it is always darkest before the light!
text.title: Sprite

text.text: Indeed great heroes! Did you think that the Pillars of Skyhaven would let you fall?! I shall champion your cause and see you thought this plight once more!
text.title: Cyclops

text.text: That mutt looks meaner than the last. Prepair yourselves for battle!
text.title: Lucas

text.text: Aye Brotha! The meaner they are, the harder they fall.
text.title: Des

text.text: We are are evils' doorstep! What more can they throw at us?
text.title: Lucas

text.text: I don't know, but I am sure it will be awful!
text.title: Rogue

text.text: Don't you fret good lookin'... What's in this place, that we can't weather?
text.title: Strider

text.text: That's right! What can't we face if we're together?
text.title: Eve

text.text: Oh... how... endearing.... but your quest for "justice" will be your undoing.
I don't know, but I sense a very powerful evil appoaching.
text.title: Eve

text.text: Ah yes, you are very close to the end now. But first, you must meet my lovely pet... Rex II the Nether Guardian!
With you dead, Nothing will ever stand in my way again!!!
text.title: Lord Magma

text.text: I have stopped you once, and I will do it again!
text.title: Enix

text.text: You are no match for me! You might as well give up and join me!
text.title: Lord Magma

text.text: Ahh! He is behind us!
text.title: Lucas

text.text: Ugh! You worthless peons are tougher then I thought! But no matter.. I AM LORD MAGMA and I will not be defeated!
text.title: Lord Magma

text.text: I am tired of listening to these evil wind bags. Let's finish him!
text.title: Strider

text.text: That is ENOUGH! I will destroy your castle if it's the last thing I do!
text.title: Lord Magma

text.text: Lord Magma, you chose the wrong path, when will you learn that evil just cannot win. Your reign ends now!
text.title: Eve

text.text: Everyone defend the castle! We must destroy him before him before he destroys our castle.
text.title: Felix

text.text: WARNING! Lord Magma is  approaching the castle! Get your troops back to the castle and destroy Lord Magma before it's too late!
You have finally arrived!
text.title: Lord Magma

text.text: Yes, and we are here to end this conflict forever!
text.title: Enix

text.text: Indeed you are, but not in the way you think. You see, your quest has been in vain. With every foe you defeated you have only strengthened me.
text.title: Lord Magma

text.text: I don't see how that can be possible. The forces of the sun have vanquished all of your strongest followers! You are all that remains of your "great" monster army.
text.title: Strider

text.text: Foolish Mortal! The very ground that you stand upon oozes with evil. The souls of your fallen enemies fill it with the stongest evil power the world has ever known. Apocalypse is upon thee!
text.title: Lord Magma

text.text: Apocalypse? pfft! We've heard that before.
text.title: Eve

text.text: Then have at me! With the addition of your souls, the Nether power from this place will overflow into the lands of Legendaria and corrupt everything you hold dear.
text.title: Lord Magma

text.text: Not if we have anything to do with it. Lord Magma is going down, his evil rule in our land ends now! It's do or die!
text.title: Lucas

text.text:
Magma Mountain endless modes unlocked! New difficulty unlocked!
					New sidescrolling level unlocked!
New Difficulty Unlocked!
The Netherworld is flooding! Dodge falling spikes and get out of the Netherworld before the portal closes!
I have the Dark Dragon's Essence!
text.title: Lucas

text.text: Lucas! You must get the Dark Essence to the Nether Portal as quickly as possible. Only you can use this power to warp us out.
text.title: Felix

text.text: Oh no! The Netherworld is crumbling around us! Spike hates green goo of death!
text.title: Spike

text.text: Don't worry, I will get this to the portal as fast as I can.
text.title: Lucas

text.text: Good Luck! I will use every last ounce of my power to keep everyone safe for as long as I can! Hurry Lucas, our fate lies with you.
text.title: Felix

text.text: You can count on me! Righteousness guide me and keep my path true! I'll catch you on the flip side!
text.title: Lucas
